meta.name: Battle of Wits: High Affinity Duel
meta.blurb: 12-round duel with hidden Crimson/Azure affinities; alternate Poisoner/Chooser roles and score 3 for your High side.
meta.author: XColos

rules: 12 rounds of hidden affinities ({num_rounds} rounds). Each player is secretly Crimson (High=Left) or Azure (High=Right). Odd rounds Player 1 is Poisoner and Player 2 Chooser; even rounds roles swap. Each round Poisoner secretly poisons Left or Right and Chooser secretly drinks Left or Right (simultaneous). Reveal: if choices match Poisoner scores, else Chooser scores. Points = {high_payoff} if the scoring player's High side equals the matched/drunk side, else {low_payoff}. Highest total after {num_rounds} wins; equal is a draw.

steps.label: seat 1 chooses
steps.text: Choose Left or Right. If you are Poisoner this is the poisoned goblet; if you are Chooser this is the goblet you drink. Roles: odd rounds you are Poisoner, even rounds Chooser.

steps.label: seat 2 chooses
steps.text: Choose Left or Right. If you are Poisoner this is the poisoned goblet; if you are Chooser this is the goblet you drink. Roles: odd rounds you are Chooser, even rounds Poisoner.

steps.label: score the round

value.calc: (high_payoff if (($c1 == 'Left' and players[0].type == 'Crimson') or ($c1 == 'Right' and players[0].type == 'Azure')) else low_payoff) if round % 2 == 1 and $c1 == $c2 else (high_payoff if (($c1 == 'Left' and players[0].type == 'Crimson') or ($c1 == 'Right' and players[0].type == 'Azure')) else low_payoff) if round % 2 == 0 and $c1 != $c2 else 0

(high_payoff if (($c2 == 'Left' and players[1].type == 'Crimson') or ($c2 == 'Right' and players[1].type == 'Azure')) else low_payoff) if round % 2 == 0 and $c1 == $c2 else (high_payoff if (($c2 == 'Left' and players[1].type == 'Crimson') or ($c2 == 'Right' and players[1].type == 'Azure')) else low_payoff) if round % 2 == 1 and $c1 != $c2 else 0

steps.text: Round {round} reveal: Seat 1 chose {last_c1}, Seat 2 chose {last_c2}.
